Glossa Lab is invitation-only. Sign in with the username and password you set when you accepted your invite.
This site is deliberately not indexed by search engines, and there is no public registration — accounts are created from invite links only.
Forgot your password? Ask an admin to disable and re-invite your account — passwords are never recoverable by email in this edition.
Setup is part of the deployment record: its completion (not the code, not the password) is written to the audit log.
— the address this invite was issued to
This invite was issued to this address, so it can’t be changed here. If you need the invite at a different address, ask whoever invited you to send a fresh one to it.
This invite was issued for a different email address.
